title: Ur-Utu
summary: Ruler listed in CFAH-15 Table 5 (Uruk IV dynasty).
description: Ruler of Uruk IV dynasty. Person record added by the CFAH pass from the per-king rows of the OSF preprint CFAH-15 (Table 5, "Baseline Reigns for Sumer, Akkad, and Babylon: Uruk IV"); its dates are display only.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year.
